name: Closed Captions
author: Benedict Armstrong
description: Live captions of what the presenter says, on the slide for every viewer. Uses the browser's speech recognition on the presenter's device.

buttons.label: Captions
buttons.tooltip: Caption what you say on every viewer screen

language.description: Spoken language, as a BCP 47 tag (en-US, de-CH, fr-FR, …).

position.description: Where captions sit on the slide.

lines.description: How many lines of captions stay on screen.

clearAfter.description: Seconds of silence before the captions fade out.

showOnPresenter.description: Also show the captions on your own current slide.
